title: Take a down round or recap
summary: A down round is a financing with extra process duties, and a recap is a down round with teeth. Confirm the alternative first: real runway, real other offers, insider appetite. A priced round below the last valuation still beats a dead company. Then run the board process like it will be read later, because in a conflicted financing it will: conflicts named, disinterested directors approving where insiders lead the round, the deliberation in the minutes, and written consents only on every director's consent where the board acts without a meeting (law rule us-de.board-action-by-written-consent in Delaware). Model the anti-dilution adjustment before signing: most charters carry broad-based weighted-average and a full ratchet is the exception, and the open anti-dilution module computes the NVCA weighted-average formula from your own numbers. Pay-to-play and pull-ups move the pain onto non-participating investors; employees feel it through the preference stack and stale strike prices, so refresh the 409A after the close and tell the team what actually changed. Educational guidance, not legal advice.

parts.title: Confirm the alternative facts first: months of runway, live offers, insider appetite, and the honest market price today

execution.rationale: The founder gathers the real alternatives through direct investor conversations and reads the runway against them; the comparison is judgment on live information.

parts.title: Run the board process for a conflicted financing: conflicts named, disinterested approval where insiders lead, the deliberation in the minutes
parts.guidance: Down rounds led by existing investors are the textbook conflicted financing, so the process is the protection: name the conflicts, let disinterested directors carry the approval where possible, document the alternatives considered, and give stockholder approvals their own clean record where the charter amendment for the new preferred requires them. Where the board acts without a meeting, Delaware requires every director's written consent (law rule us-de.board-action-by-written-consent).

references.title: 8 Del. C. ch. 1, subch. IV — directors and officers

geoResolutions.label: Delaware board mechanics: a meeting with minutes, or action without a meeting only on every director's written consent (law rule us-de.board-action-by-written-consent), with stockholder approval where the charter amendment requires it

execution.rationale: Directors deliberate and approve under counsel's guidance; the consents and minutes are signature acts and the fiduciary judgment is the board's own.

parts.title: Model the conversion-price adjustment before signing: weighted-average or ratchet, from the charter's own formula
parts.guidance: The existing preferred's anti-dilution clause resets conversion prices at the new round's lower price. Run the charter's actual formula: the open anti-dilution module computes the NVCA broad-based weighted-average adjustment from the real share counts, and a full ratchet is modeled as what it is, a reset to the new price.

execution.rationale: Compute the weighted-average or ratchet adjustment from the supplied cap table and charter formula; the signed documents, not the model, set the final numbers.

parts.title: Negotiate the recap terms with eyes open: pay-to-play, pull-ups, the option-pool refresh, and who converts to common

execution.rationale: The founder and counsel negotiate the structure with the new money and the existing preferred directly; the terms allocate losses among real parties.

parts.title: Refresh the 409A after the close: the old strike prices are stale the day the repriced round lands

execution.rationale: The valuation engagement and its review run through the provider's process on the company's new facts; the referenced record carries the mechanics.

parts.title: Tell employees what changed: the preference stack, their options against the new 409A, and why the company is still alive

execution.rationale: The founder explains the round to the team directly; equity questions from employees deserve personal, accurate answers.

metadata.trigger: The only real term sheet prices the company below the last round, or the insiders propose a recapitalization as the condition of new money.
metadata.supportReason: The negotiation and the board's conflicted-financing process are human work; an agent can run the anti-dilution math from the cap table and the charter formula and draft the employee-facing explanation of the new stack.

contextNeeded.query: the proposed term sheet and the existing charter's anti-dilution formula
the current cap table with the preferred classes and option pool
